title: Best decision was to book a guided tour
text: One of the best decisions was to book a tour for this attraction that lasted about 3 hours. We walked approximate 7 kilometers during this experience and our tour guide Maria Jose was exceptional and very professional, knowledgeable and entertaining. We learned quiet a few interesting things during this wonderful tour.
